description: This file defines a React component named DeploymentStatusBarChart that renders a bar chart visualizing deployment statuses and counts. It includes internal methods for rendering tooltips, labels, and handling user interactions, and imports several external libraries and components such as recharts, PropTypes, and custom utility modules.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a custom tooltip for the bar chart, showing deployment status and count.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: A React component that renders the value labels above each bar in the chart.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: A function that logs user interactions such as bar clicks and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
